name: FA_MASS_TRANSACTIONS
description: FA_MASS_TRANSACTIONS contains information about mass transaction requests.  Oracle Fusion Assets stores basic information about the transactions, as well as the criteria used to select all candidate assets for the mass transactions in this table.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Identifier number of the mass transaction.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Name of the asset book for which the mass transaction is defined.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Unique user-defined name for the mass transaction.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Overall status for the mass transaction batch. Possible values are NEW, IN PROGRESS, and POSTED.

columns.name: MASS_TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Mass transaction classification. Possible values are FINANCIAL, RETIREMENT, and TRANSFER.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Detailed transaction type for the various mass transactions. Possible values are ADJUSTMENT, GROUP CHANGE, RECLASS, SUSPEND, and RESUME.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE_ENTERED
columns.description: Transaction date for the selected transaction type.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NAME
columns.description: User-defined description of the mass transaction.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the transaction is to be amortized or not.

columns.name: CREATE_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the asset candidate selection job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: POST_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface posting job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FROM_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Starting value of the asset number range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: TO_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Ending value of the asset number range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: FROM_DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Starting value of the date placed in service range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: TO_DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Ending value of the date placed in service range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: FROM_COST
columns.description: Starting value of the cost range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: TO_COST
columns.description: Ending value of the cost range used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: Asset type used to select candidate assets.  Possible asset types are capitalized, expensed, construction in process, or group.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_NAME
columns.description: Manufacturer name used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: MODEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Model number used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: SERIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Serial number used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: TAG_NUMBER
columns.description: Tag number used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Depreciation method used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: LIFE_IN_YEARS
columns.description: Life in years used to select candidate assets depreciating under a calculated, table, or formula depreciation method.

columns.name: LIFE_IN_MONTHS
columns.description: Life in months used to select candidate assets depreciating under a calculated, table, or formula depreciation method.

columns.name: BASIC_RATE
columns.description: Basic rate used to select candidate assets depreciating under a flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_RATE
columns.description: Adjusted rate used to select candidate assets depreciating under a flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_CAPACITY
columns.description: Total production capacity used to select candidate assets depreciating under a units of production depreciation method.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Unit of measure used to select candidate assets depreciating under a units of production depreciation method.

columns.name: CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation prorate convention used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: CEILING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation ceiling used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRECIATE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is depreciating or not.

columns.name: SALVAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Salvage type used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_PERCENT
columns.description: Salvage value percentage used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value amount used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Depreciation limit type used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_PERCENT
columns.description: Depreciation limit percentage used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation limit amount used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSOCIATION
columns.description: Group asset association used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the group asset used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: CASH_GENERATING_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the cash generating unit used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_TO
columns.description: Identifier of the person used to select candidate assets.

columns.name: INCLUDE_FULLY_RESERVED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether to include fully reserved assets when selecting candidate assets.

columns.name: INCLUDE_SUBCOMPONENTS_FLAG
columns.description: Option to include child assets of the matching candidate assets for the mass transaction.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Original batch name of a mass retirement used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: FROM_DATE_RETIRED
columns.description: Starting value of the date placed in service range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: TO_DATE_RETIRED
columns.description: Ending value of the date placed in service range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: FROM_COST_RETIRED
columns.description: Starting value of the cost range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: TO_COST_RETIRED
columns.description: Ending value of the cost range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: FROM_TRADE_IN_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Starting value of the trade-in asset number range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: TO_TRADE_IN_ASSET_NUMBER
columns.description: Ending value of the trade-in asset number range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: FROM_PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Starting value of the proceeds of sale range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: TO_PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Ending value of the proceeds of sale range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: FROM_COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Starting value of the cost of removal range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: TO_COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Ending value of the cost of removal range used to select candidate assets for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Internal identification number of the retirement type used to select candidate asset retirements for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: RETIREMENT_CONVENTION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Internal identification number of the retirement prorate convention used to select candidate asset retirements for mass reinstatement.

columns.name: SOLD_TO
columns.description: Name of the customer to whom the asset was sold. Used for mass reinstatements.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NUM
columns.description: Internal reference number used on selected candidate assets for mass reinstatement.
